midwife--noun.def: A person trained to help women give birth.
midwife--noun.ex: The midwife arrived within the hour.

reap--verb.def: To cut and gather a crop, or to receive a result.
reap--verb.ex: They reaped the benefits for years.

deceit--noun.def: Behaviour that makes people believe something untrue.
deceit--noun.ex: The whole scheme rested on deceit.

battered--adj.def: Old and damaged from long use or rough treatment.
battered--adj.ex: He drove a battered old van.

peninsula--noun.def: A piece of land almost surrounded by water.
peninsula--noun.ex: The peninsula has three fishing villages.

radiator--noun.def: A metal device that heats a room or cools an engine.

somber--adj.def: Serious and sad, or dark in colour.
somber--adj.ex: The mood was somber after the news.

indefinitely--adv.def: For a period with no known end.

manipulation--noun.def: Controlling someone or something unfairly or skilfully.
manipulation--noun.ex: The report warns of market manipulation.

ploy--noun.def: A clever action meant to gain an advantage.
ploy--noun.ex: The delay was a deliberate ploy.

suburban--adj.def: Relating to the residential areas around a city.
suburban--adj.ex: They live in a suburban street.

muscular--adj.def: Having well developed muscles, or relating to muscles.

incision--noun.def: A careful cut made by a surgeon.
incision--noun.ex: The surgeon made a small incision.

slob--noun.ex: Do not be such a slob.

rotate--verb.def: To turn around a centre, or to take turns doing something.
rotate--verb.ex: The staff rotate the night shift.

confide--verb.def: To tell someone a secret because you trust them.

customary--adj.def: Usual because it is the custom.
customary--adj.ex: It is customary to bring a gift.

simplicity--noun.def: The quality of being easy to understand or plain in design.
simplicity--noun.ex: The simplicity of the plan appealed to us.

ventilation--noun.def: The movement of fresh air into a building.
ventilation--noun.exTr: Bodrumun daha iyi havalandırmaya ihtiyacı var.

buffer--verb.def: To protect something from a shock or a bad effect.
buffer--verb.ex: Savings buffered the family against the loss.

buffer--noun.def: Something that protects one thing from another.
buffer--noun.ex: The trees act as a buffer against wind.
buffer--noun.exTr: Ağaçlar rüzgâra karşı tampon görevi görüyor.

boast--noun.def: A statement praising yourself too much.

gourmet--adj.def: Of very high quality, said of food.

gourmet--noun.def: A person who knows a lot about good food.
gourmet--noun.ex: Her uncle is a real gourmet.

frosty--adj.def: Very cold with frost, or unfriendly in manner.
frosty--adj.ex: It was a clear frosty morning.

criteria--noun.def: The standards used to judge or to decide something.

hypocrisy--noun.def: Saying one thing while doing another.

psyche--noun.def: The human mind and its deepest feelings.
psyche--noun.ex: The war marked the national psyche.

succession--noun.def: A series of things one after another, or the right to follow in a role.
succession--noun.ex: They won five games in succession.

structural--adj.def: Relating to the structure of a building or a system.

atmospheric--adj.def: Relating to the air, or creating a special mood.
atmospheric--adj.ex: The café is small and atmospheric.
atmospheric--adj.exTr: Kafe küçük ve havası olan bir yer.

flask--noun.def: A container that keeps a drink hot or cold.
flask--noun.ex: She filled a flask with tea.

bearded--adj.ex: A bearded man opened the door.

domination--noun.def: Control over other people or countries.
domination--noun.ex: The team ended years of domination.
domination--noun.exTr: Takım yıllarca süren hâkimiyete son verdi.

persecution--noun.def: Cruel treatment of a group because of their beliefs.

consultation--noun.def: A meeting to get advice, or a discussion before a decision.

agreeable--adj.def: Pleasant, or willing to accept something.
agreeable--adj.ex: Both sides were agreeable to the plan.

speculate--verb.def: To guess about something without full evidence.
speculate--verb.ex: The papers speculated about his health.

bribery--noun.def: The crime of giving money to influence a decision.
bribery--noun.exTr: İki görevli rüşvet suçlamasıyla karşı karşıya.

geological--adj.def: Relating to rocks and the earth's structure.
geological--adj.ex: The survey found a geological fault.

wary--adj.def: Careful because you fear a problem.
wary--adj.ex: She is wary of easy promises.

stamina--noun.def: The strength to keep going for a long time.
stamina--noun.ex: The race tests stamina more than speed.

graft--verb.def: To join part of one plant or body onto another.
graft--verb.ex: They grafted a new branch onto the tree.

sequel--noun.def: A book or a film that continues an earlier story.
sequel--noun.ex: The sequel came out two years later.

exploitation--noun.def: Unfair use of people or resources for profit.

vegetation--noun.def: The plants that grow in a particular area.
vegetation--noun.exTr: Yamacı sık bir bitki örtüsü kaplıyor.

spartan--adj.ex: The room was clean but spartan.

flattery--noun.ex: Flattery will not change my mind.

thereby--adv.def: As a result of that action, in formal English.
thereby--adv.ex: He signed, thereby ending the dispute.

acre--noun.def: A unit of land equal to about four thousand square metres.

itinerary--noun.def: A plan of a journey with dates and places.

apt--adj.def: Suitable for the situation, or likely to do something.

oversee--verb.def: To watch over work to make sure it is done well.

fanatic--noun.def: A person with extreme and uncritical enthusiasm.

acoustic--adj.def: Relating to sound, or not using electrical amplification.

twitch--verb.def: To make a small sudden uncontrolled movement.

twitch--noun.def: A small sudden movement of a muscle.
twitch--noun.ex: She noticed a twitch in his hand.

ludicrous--adj.def: So unreasonable that it deserves laughter.

predecessor--noun.def: The person who had a job before the current one.

provocative--adj.def: Meant to cause anger or strong discussion.

neutralize--verb.def: To stop something having an effect.

manicure--noun.def: A treatment that cleans and shapes the fingernails.

manicure--verb.def: To care for and shape the fingernails.

endorsement--noun.def: Public support for a person or a product.

immensely--adv.def: Extremely, to a very great degree.

adversary--noun.def: An opponent in a fight or an argument.

unison--noun.def: The state of doing or saying something together.

profoundly--adv.def: In a very great or deep way.

grapefruit--noun.def: A large yellow citrus fruit with a slightly bitter taste.
grapefruit--noun.ex: He eats half a grapefruit daily.

ingenuity--noun.def: Cleverness in finding new ways to solve problems.

ghostly--adj.def: Pale and frightening like a ghost.
ghostly--adj.ex: A ghostly light moved in the fog.
ghostly--adj.exTr: Siste hayaletimsi bir ışık hareket etti.

bubbly--adj.def: Full of bubbles, or lively and cheerful.

embark--verb.def: To start something new, or to get on a ship.
embark--verb.ex: They embarked on a long study.

benign--adj.def: Not harmful, especially of a growth in the body.
